title: GoOrganicAfrica 44-country calculator data completion — batch 01

countries.name: Benin
countries.source_notes: Benin ESA 2024 dataset was released 11 June 2026; survey includes crop area, production, yields and input-use indicators, but not yet a complete set of enterprise cost budgets. DSA reports 2023/24 output indicators for maize, rice, cassava and soybean. Official 2025 cereal output estimate is about 2.9 million tonnes; aggregate only, not a crop-specific calculator yield.
blockers: Download and extract ESA 2024 crop-by-crop tables with area, output, yield, region and season.
Obtain dated farmgate prices by crop and department.
Obtain actual seed, fertilizer, crop protection, labour and machinery prices; ESA input-use indicators alone do not establish current unit costs.
Build and validate crop enterprise budgets.

countries.name: Burkina Faso
countries.source_notes: FAO reported official 2024 aggregate cereal production of 6.1 million tonnes, about 20% above the previous five-year average; localized production deficits and access constraints were noted in conflict-affected regions. FAO/50x2030 announced release of the 2024/25 Permanent Agricultural Survey and RGA phase-II horticulture/arboriculture modules on 15 October 2026. FAO GIEWS recorded May 2025 millet and sorghum wholesale price movements, which are historical wholesale observations, not current farmgate prices.
blockers: Extract EPA 2024/25 crop tables by crop, region, area and yield.
Extract RGA horticulture/tree crop modules where relevant.
Obtain current market-level and farmgate prices; do not reuse May 2025 wholesale movements as current prices.
Obtain regional input and labour quotations; conflict/access differences require regional segmentation.
Build crop budgets with explicit season and region.

countries.name: Côte d'Ivoire
countries.source_notes: Official government crop series gives 2024 output (thousand tonnes) for yams 7,660.9; cassava 8,485.7; plantain 2,465.2; sweet potato 63.1; taro 91.2. These are production totals only; matching area data is needed to calculate yields. Government reporting states the 2025/26 cocoa producer price is 2,800 FCFA/kg; keep this crop- and season-specific and do not generalize it to other commodities.
blockers: Extract matching crop-area series and calculate/check yields by crop.
Verify the cocoa producer-price effective dates, grade/quality conditions and payment basis before using.
Collect farmgate prices for other priority crops and current input quotations.
Build crop-specific budgets and regional assumptions.

countries.name: Senegal
countries.source_notes: Senegal released EAA 2024/25 data in June 2026. The annual survey covers all 14 regions and 45 departments. The 2024/25 Income, Labour and Productivity module captures input use and associated costs, alongside horticulture, livestock and fisheries/aquaculture. This is a strong source for building budgets, but the crop-level tables and microdata still need extraction and review.
blockers: Download DAPSA data portal tables and ANADS microdata catalogue records.
Extract crop-season-area-production-yield by region/department.
Extract input and labour cost variables and inspect units/coverage.
Collect dated farmgate prices and machinery/irrigation costs where not covered.
Build regionally representative enterprise budgets.

countries.name: Togo
countries.source_notes: FAO GIEWS reports 2025 aggregate cereal production of nearly 1.7 million tonnes, about 15% above the previous five-year average. In 2026, agricultural labour costs in conflict-affected Savanes reportedly rose 10–20% versus the previous season; this is a regional labour-cost signal, not a national wage schedule. The 2026 Togo yearbook provides sector context, but detailed crop-level budget tables still need extraction.
blockers: Extract crop-level area, production and yield tables from the national statistical portal/yearbook.
Obtain current market and farmgate price series with market/date/unit.
Verify regional labour costs, especially Savanes, with dated source and operation basis.
Obtain current input, machinery and irrigation costs and construct crop budgets.

interpretation: This batch identifies official source material and specific extraction tasks. None of these five countries is certified calculator-ready. Production totals are not yields unless corresponding crop area and season definitions are available. Wholesale/consumer prices are not farmgate prices. Aggregate national production is not a substitute for enterprise budgets.
next_batch: Extract the released Benin ESA 2024 and Senegal EAA 2024/25 tables first; these provide the clearest structured route to crop and input-cost observations. Then obtain Burkina EPA 2024/25 tables and continue with the remaining country register.
